title: Microsoft, Nvidia CEOs to unveil new AI laptop at San Francisco event
hook_text: Microsoft and Nvidia just teamed up.
script:
Microsoft and Nvidia just teamed up.
Their CEOs are unveiling a powerful new AI laptop in San Francisco today.
The device runs complex models locally without needing the cloud.
That means instant responses for heavy coding and rendering tasks.
Would you buy an AI laptop?
